reason.en: No one can legally guarantee returns in the securities market. SEBI-registered advisers are expressly barred from promising assured profits, so a 'guaranteed return' pitch is one of the most reliable signs of a scam.

citation.label: SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 — advisers must not assure returns

action.en: Do not pay or share any details. A guaranteed-return claim is a red flag on its own.

label.en: Claims to be SEBI registered or approved

reason.en: Scammers routinely claim SEBI registration or 'SEBI approval' to sound legitimate. SEBI never 'approves' schemes or guarantees anyone's performance. Any registration number must be verified against SEBI's own registry — the claim alone means nothing.

citation.label: Verify intermediaries on SEBI's official registry

action.en: Verify the exact registration number and name in Satark's registry check before trusting the claim.

label.en: Asks for an upfront fee to join or get 'VIP tips'

reason.en: Legitimate investor protection is free. Demands for an upfront 'activation', 'VIP', or 'joining' fee before you can see results are a classic advance-fee trap.

citation.label: Common advance-fee fraud pattern flagged in SEBI investor alerts

action.en: Never pay an upfront fee to a stranger promising profits.

label.en: Pushes you into a Telegram / WhatsApp 'tip' group

reason.en: Pump-and-dump rings herd investors into Telegram/WhatsApp groups, hype a stock they already hold, then sell into the crowd. The 'free group' is the bait.

citation.label: SEBI has warned against unregistered 'tip' groups and pump-and-dump schemes

action.en: Treat stock calls from these groups as manipulation, not advice.

label.en: Asks you to install a remote-access or unknown app

reason.en: Remote-access apps let a stranger see and control your phone, including your bank and Demat apps. No genuine official will ever ask you to install one.

citation.label: RBI / SEBI / cyber-crime advisories on remote-access app fraud

action.en: Do not install it. If you already did, disconnect the internet and uninstall it now.

reason.en: Urgency is engineered to stop you from thinking or verifying. A real investment decision never expires in minutes.

citation.label: Behavioural manipulation tactic common to financial scams

action.en: Slow down. Pressure to act 'right now' is itself a warning sign.
